text:
maria: FYI — after the CNI upgrade to 1.20 this morning we're seeing elevated east-west packet drops for small payloads on GPU clusters in us-west2.
raj: got alerts. are drops across all pods or just some namespaces?
maria: narrow so far to kubeflow and training namespaces, mostly 100-300B packets. pod-to-pod traffic times out, training jobs hang during all-reduce.
kai: example flow: worker->ps and pod-to-pod nv_peer_mem RDMA handshakes failing intermittently.
anna: any MTU changes during the rollout? 1.20 changed vxlan/geneve defaults in our helm values?
maria: we kept MTU same (9000) in config, but nodes show 1450 on cni0 after upgrade on a subset of nodes.
raj: that smells like inconsistent MTU between host and tunnel interface. can you paste `ip link show` and `ifconfig` from an affected node?
maria: paste below from node gpu-w2-13:

```
root@gpu-w2-13:~# ip link show cni0
5: cni0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1450 qdisc noqueue state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 0a:58:0a:xx:xx:xx brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
root@gpu-w2-13:~# ip link show ens192
2: ens192: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
```

maria: so host iface is 9000, cni0 is 1450, that's inconsistent.
raj: were any of the Cilium TUN options changed? e.g., ENCAP mode?
kai: upgrade notes mention geneve defaults changed to honor ENCAP_MTU but we used a custom helm value — maybe bug.
anna: also seeing high GSO/GRO counts in kernel offload stats on those nodes. small packet fragmentation could be mishandled when offloading enabled.
raj: can you show `sudo ethtool -k ens192` from same host?
maria: here:

```
root@gpu-w2-13:~# ethtool -k ens192
rx-checksum: on
tx-checksum-ip-generic: on
generic-segmentation-offload: on
generic-receive-offload: on
large-receive-offload: on
```

maria: disabling GSO temporarily reduced application-level packet drops in one test.
kai: hypothesis: tunnel MTU mismatch + GSO causing oversized segmented packets that geneve drops -> observed as small-packet loss for RDMA/tcp.
raj: short mitigation: set cni0 MTU to 9000 or set tunnel mtu to 9000 in Cilium config, OR disable GSO/GRO on host as short-lived workaround.
anna: disabling GSO across fleet is risky for throughput. prefer to fix MTU/tunnel settings and roll back any helm chart change.
infra-oncall: started a canary rollback on 3 nodes in us-west2 to cilium 1.19, routing traffic to older nodes for affected namespaces.
sre-bot: deploy/rollback job started for cilium-release v1.19 -> 3 nodes in us-west2. Job ID: deploy-5621
maria: after rollback to 1.19 on 3 nodes, pod-to-pod tests show steady latency and no packet loss for 15m.
kai: need a repro and root cause. can we capture tcpdump on pod veth + tunnel on an affected node while running a small-payload all-reduce test?
raj: also run `cilium monitor` and check geneve headers. capture pcap and check for segmentation flags and invalid checksum offloads.
anna: opened ticket with Cilium: https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/XXXXX (link to our report). Included `ip link`/`ethtool` dumps and dmesg.
maria: quick workaround we applied cluster-wide: set CNI tunnel MTU to 8950 (9000 minus overhead) in Helm for new nodes, and added kubelet node annotation to enforce cni mtu.
raj: add a rollout gate: don't upgrade more nodes until we have validation script that runs pod-to-pod RDMA smoke tests and confirms MTU on both host and cni0.
kai: created a test job: `tools/infra/ci/rdma-smoke` — it runs iperf, small-message MPI all-reduce, and checks `ip link` MTU alignment. link: https://ci.internal/rdma-smoke/123
anna: follow-ups:
- triage Cilium config diff between 1.19 and 1.20 helm values
- add e2e MTU/GSO smoke to upgrade pipeline
- coordinate with Cilium about geneve mtu handling + offload combos
- schedule full rollback plan if more nodes degrade
maria: logging notes: correlated kernel dmesg on affected nodes shows geneve: drop due to skb->len > mtu and gso flag set.

[ 12345.678901] geneve: packet too large (len 65536 > mtu 1450) dropping

raj: ok let's keep the rollback rolling for now. @anna can you own the canary gating and add the smoke job to CI? @kai please collect pcaps and send to Cilium issue.
anna: will do. gate will block upgrades until smoke passes on canary.
kai: uploading pcap now to the issue.
infra-oncall: note added to incident board. paging policy temporarily relaxed for this class of packet-loss alert.
maria: thanks team. ping here when we have reproducer and cilium response. :thumbsup:
